items.title: Mosaic (MOS) Rallies After A Loss Making Quarter, Is The 11% Undervaluation Real?
items.summary: Mosaic (MOS) moved back into the spotlight after its third quarter update, as the fertilizer producer reported a net loss alongside lower sales while outlining ongoing cost cuts and cautious restart plans. Mosaic’s latest update hit a market that had already been cautious, yet the stock has surged recently. The 7 day share price return is 24.81% and the 30 day share price return is 22.68%, from a base that leaves the year to date share price return still down 8.11%. Scan the fertilizer space...

items.title: Mosaic (MOS) Stock May Be Undervalued As Recovery Plans Take Shape
items.summary: Mosaic has just logged a sharp short term rebound in its share price, even as its longer term returns remain weak. This puts fresh focus on whether the current valuation lines up with its sales base. With the business working through operational and financing changes, the question is how much revenue investors are really paying for today. Over the past 5 years, Mosaic shareholders have seen the stock fall 29.7%. This makes the current pricing against its sales a key issue for anyone thinking...
